Name: Desaturated Cute Cribs
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
Ah I'm almost beginning to prefer this desaturated version of my 'Cute' series.... it's just so cute <3 

UPDATE 1.1.0: Added 9 new crib options in 3 different green colour palettes. Also, added an option in 'config' settings to 'enable' or 'disable' this mod, so that you can quickly and easily switch between different crib mods!

Anyways, this is just a crib mod! choose one of 30 options within your GMCM to override the vanilla game crib <3

[size=4]NOTE: If you use DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors, hop down to the bottom of this description and read my note <3[/size] 

This mod is part of my 'Cute' series, more precisely, my 'Desaturated Cute' series. If you'd like the rest of the desaturated furniture, check out this mod page: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34472]Desaturated Cute Furniture[/url]. as of June 8th 2025, Desaturated Cute Furniture includes beds+ single beds+ child beds+ rugs, however, I am working on 'Cute Couches' right now and that will be the next update for Desaturated Cute Furniture as well. More updates to follow as well! I plan to have a full-fledged "Cute" "Desaturated Cute" and "Green Cute" furniture series out in due time <3 

[size=3]₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊ I just released [url=https://youtu.be/mU9H2whIVm4]THIS youtube video[/url] showcasing all of my 'Cute' furniture so far!!! (cribs, beds, rugs) come check it out if you please!![/size][size=3]! ₊✩‧₊˚౨ৎ˚₊✩‧₊  AND [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/AQRsERzRp4c]THIS youtube short[/url] showcases the desaturated versions![/size]

I'm so happy with these adorable little cribs. I can't wait to create custom nursery furniture and decorations to match! <3 I think my favorite is still the 'dreamy' colourway, but... 'grape' and 'minty' are also really growing on me! idek they're all just so cute ⸜(｡˃ ᵕ ˂ )⸝♡

HOW TO INSTALL: 
1. ensure you have Content Patcher, SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu installed
2. download my file!!
3. unzip my file into your 'Mods' folder
4. Go into your GMCM menu and scroll through the list/select your option! Now your crib will be ⋆˙⟡CUTE⋆˙⟡

WHAT AM I WORKING ON NEXT:
1. A separate version of my 'Cute' series all dedicated to the colour GREEN! I am planning for 3 colour palettes of green with all wood grains <3 I will first release green rugs + beds and then update the mod as I create more furniture!
2. A character replacement for Guts from Berserk (˶˃ ᵕ ˂˶)
3. More hairstyle mods for different NPCs... there are also quite a few that I'd like to make look more... attractive? cuter? 
4. Cute Couches and more cute furniture series mods (including desaturated cute + green cute)
ah and I have so many more things coming! These will be first though!!! ^

NOTE: for those using DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors-- Earthy Interiors is a mod that affects the map tiles, which the crib is a part of (it's not like regular furniture where you can have more than one). If you want a simple solution to use both, you can toggle "RecolourFarmhouseFurniture" to false within DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors in GMCM, however, I can understand that you do not want to loose the aesthetics within your farmhouse this way (the mod will still be displayed in all other areas- town interior, lighting, chairs, bathhouse etc), so if you want to be able to use the earthy interiors within your house and this crib mod, send me a message and I can walk you through the steps of coming to a solution <3
